name: Harper Anderson
why: A sharp, well lit head-and-shoulders portrait of her alone against a brick wall, published by WKU itself. The only Herald photograph of her has her face buried in someone's shoulder, so this is far and away the best frame of her in any WKU source.
caption_quote: Harper Anderson, Outstanding Major in Criminology
identification: The page is about her and nobody else, it carries exactly one photograph, and its heading prints her name. The text beneath is her own first-person statement and names the office outright: 'During my time at WKU, I have become involved as a Spirit Master, Academic Excellence Chair of Kappa Delta Sorority, President of Pi Alpha Delta Pre-Law Society, Administrative Vice President of Student Government Association'. Cross-checked against a second WKU page, the Political Science department's student card at /political-science/harperandersonprofile.php, which prints 'Harper Anderson, Major: Political Science | Class of 2021, Morehead, KY' beside a full-length photograph of the same woman.
